nights.title: Pinhani
nights.name: Pinhani
nights.extract: Pinhâni is a Turkish alternative rock band. It was founded on 5 April 2004 by two cousins Sinan Kaynakçı and Zeynep Eylül Üçer as a modern rock band in Turkey. Pinhani have released several albums. Pinhani also made the soundtrack for the Turkish TV Series 'Kavak Yelleri'.

en.who: Pinhani is a Turkish alternative rock band founded in 2004 by two cousins, Sinan Kaynakçı and Zeynep Eylül Üçer. The band has released several albums.
facts: Pinhani made the soundtrack for the Turkish TV series Kavak Yelleri.

de.who: Pinhani ist eine türkische Alternative-Rockband, die 2004 von zwei Cousins gegründet wurde: Sinan Kaynakçı und Zeynep Eylül Üçer. Die Band hat mehrere Alben veröffentlicht.
facts: Die Band wurde am 5. April 2004 gegründet.
Pinhani schrieb den Soundtrack zur türkischen TV-Serie Kavak Yelleri.

tr.who: Pinhani, 2004'te iki kuzen Sinan Kaynakçı ve Zeynep Eylül Üçer tarafından kurulmuş bir Türk alternatif rock grubudur. Grup birkaç albüm yayımladı.
facts: Pinhani, Türk dizisi Kavak Yelleri'nin müziklerini yaptı.
